start_welcome: Hello, {name}! 👋 Send your MLBB Account ID and Server/Zone ID and I'll determine the server for you. Frequently used functions are on the keyboard below.
check_prompt: 🔎 Server check Please send your MLBB Account ID and Server/Zone ID. Example: 1289050 (10050) /check 1289050 (10050) 📌 If only the Account ID is sent, the server cannot be determined accurately.
failed_lookup_body: The user or server was not found.
invalid_mlbb_input: Server not found. Please check the Account ID and Server/Zone ID and send them again.
help_section_server: 1. MLBB server check Send your Account ID and Server/Zone ID. The bot determines the profile through the MLBB official server. Formats: 1289050 (10050) 1289050 10050 /check 1289050 10050
help_section_keyboard: 2. Keyboard You can use the main functions with the buttons below without typing a command.
help_section_limitations: 3. Limitations If only the Account ID is sent, the MLBB server cannot be determined accurately.
cmd_start: /start — start the bot and show the keyboard
cmd_full_info: /fullinfo [id] [serv] — full account information (brackets and quotes are removed automatically)
cmd_feedback: /feedback or /fikr — send a suggestion or complaint
cmd_message: /message Text — send a message to all users with confirmation
unknown_text:
I didn't understand what you meant 🙂
Better use the buttons below.
admin_only: This section is for admins only!
error_unexpected:
An unexpected error occurred, but I'm still working.

Please send the ID again in this format:
1289050 (10050)
bind_info_limit_reached: ⛔️ Daily limit reached! The bindings check service can be used only 10 times per day. Contact @obitomlb or @vafoyev_n to extend your daily limit. Please try again tomorrow or after 00:00.
invalid_bind_input: Bindings not found. Please check the Account ID and Server/Zone ID and send them again.
bind_failed_bridge_not_configured:
The bridge endpoint is not configured to check bindings through the provider.
The error was reported to the admins, try again once the settings are updated.
bind_failed_bengkel_parse:
Could not read the bindings from the Bengkel bot response.
Please check the ID and Server/Zone ID and send them again.
bind_failed_no_data:
Could not get bindings information.
The provider did not return linked-account data for this account.
bind_failed_auth_required:
Authorization is required to connect to the bindings provider.
The error was reported to the admins, try again once the settings are updated.
bind_failed_provider_down:
The bindings provider address is down or has changed.
The error was reported to the admins, try again in a bit.
bind_failed_provider_timeout:
The bindings provider responded slowly.
Please try again in a bit.
bind_failed_provider_unavailable:
The bindings provider is temporarily not responding.
Please try again in a bit.
bind_failed_generic:
Could not get a response from the database to get the information.
Please try again in a bit.
bind_info_wait: 🙏 Checking bindings... Please wait. This may take a while.
inline_bind_description: Tap — the result will be sent to this chat
inline_server_description: Tap — the region result will be sent to this chat
feedback_prompt: 💬 Feedback Write the feature you need, a suggestion or a complaint. Your message will be delivered to the admins. If an admin replies, the reply will come to you through the bot. Press /cancel to cancel.
feedback_text_required:
Feedback must be in text form.
Please write your suggestion or complaint.
feedback_too_long: The feedback is too long. Please write less than {maxLength} characters.
feedback_thanks: ✅ Your feedback was sent. Wait for a reply, it will arrive here.
feedback_thanks_failed: ✅ Your feedback was sent. There was an error delivering it to the admins right now. Please try again in a bit.
admin_feedback_hint: You can reply to this message to answer.
admin_feedback_reply_sent: ✅ Reply sent to the user. User ID: {userId}{feedbackLine}
admin_feedback_reply_required: The reply sent to the user must be in text form.
admin_feedback_reply_failed: ❌ Could not send the reply to the user. User ID: {userId}{feedbackLine}{reasonLine}
stats_errors_moved: Errors were moved to a separate admin button: ⚠️ Errors.
stats_monthly_no_data: Monthly activity has not been recorded yet.
stats_monthly_supabase_error: There is an error reading Supabase, monthly statistics are temporarily unavailable.
stats_monthly_not_configured: Supabase is not connected. Current runtime: {count} users.
stats_today_supabase_error: There is an error reading Supabase, today's local users were not found.
users_supabase_read_error: There is an error reading Supabase.
broadcast_usage_hint: All formats are preserved: • Bold — **text** or Telegram format • Italic — _text_ • __Underline__ — __text__ • ~~Strikethrough~~ — ~text~ • ||Secret (spoiler)|| — ||text|| • > Quote (blockquote) — Telegram format • Code — `text` • Link — [text](url) • Premium emoji — preserved To send a sticker/media, reply to that message and write /message. A confirmation button will appear in the next step.
broadcast_too_long: The message is too long. Please send a text shorter than 3500 characters.
broadcast_expired: This confirmation is outdated or not found. Restart with /message.
broadcast_confirm_body: Nothing has been sent to anyone yet. Sending starts only after pressing the confirm button below.
broadcast_confirm_audience: 👥 Total in list: {total} ✅ In private chat — sent: {private} ⏭️ Group only — skipped: {groupOnly}
broadcast_queued_body:
Sending is being done in the background (via queue) — it may take a few minutes.
When it's all done, the final report (Total / Sent / Blocked / Error) will arrive in this chat.
broadcast_queued_error: ❌ There was an error queuing the message. Try again (/message).
mandatory_setup_current: Current group: {title} ({id}) To set a new group, send the group ID (or @username). Press /unset_mandatory to remove it.
mandatory_setup_empty:
Currently no group is mandatory.

To set a group, send its ID (or @username). Note: the bot must be an admin in that group or channel!
mandatory_setup_not_found: ❌ Group not found or the bot is not an admin there: {error}
mandatory_not_invite_link: ❌ The group has no public username or invite link. Create a link first.
check_membership_title: ⚠️ You must join the group to use the bot! Please join the group below and get full access to the bot.
check_membership_success: ✅ Your membership in the group is confirmed. You can freely use the bot!
check_membership_not_member: ❌ You haven't joined the group yet! Please join the group.
full_info_prompt: 📋 Full info Send your MLBB Account ID and Server/Zone ID and I'll gather all the information about the account. Example: 1289050 (10050)
full_info_wait: 🙏 Collecting information... Please wait. This may take a while.
full_info_invalid_input: Information not found. Please check the Account ID and Server/Zone ID and send them again.
full_info_failed_generic:
❌ Could not get the account's full information.
Please try again in a bit.
full_info_failed_quota:

full_info_failed_not_found:

Check the Player ID or Server/Zone ID and send them again.
full_info_failed_rate_limited:

full_info_failed_timeout:

full_info_post_link_hint: You can view the full information using the button below:
full_info_limit_reached: ⛔️ Limit reached! Your full-info check packages have run out. 📦 To purchase a new package, contact @{supportUsername}
full_info_service_unavailable: ⚠️ The full-info service is temporarily unavailable. There is no connection to the limit system. Please try again in a bit or report to the admins: @{supportUsername}
full_info_quota_remaining: 📦 Full-info checks remaining in your package: {remaining}

cmd_limit_fullinfo: /limit_fullinfo [tgid] [limit] — add to a user's full-info package (added on top of the remaining balance)
cmd_reset_pw: /resetpw email or /parol — send a password reset email for a Moonton account
cmd_limit_resetpw: /limit_resetpw [tgid] [limit] — add to a user's password-reset package (added on top of the remaining balance)
reset_pw_prompt: 🔐 Password reset Send the Moonton email bound to the account — Moonton will send you a password reset email. Example: example@mail.com
reset_pw_wait: 🙏 Sending the password reset request... Please wait. This may take 15-30 seconds.
reset_pw_invalid_email: ❌ The email address looks invalid. Please send a correct email. Example: example@mail.com
reset_pw_success: ✅ Password reset email sent! 📧 Address: {email} Please check your Inbox and Spam. If the email doesn't arrive, wait a bit and try again.
reset_pw_limit_reached: ⛔️ Limit reached! Your password-reset packages have run out. 📦 To purchase a new package, contact @{supportUsername}
reset_pw_service_unavailable: ⚠️ The password reset service is temporarily unavailable. There is no connection to the limit system. Please try again in a bit or report to the admins: @{supportUsername}
reset_pw_quota_remaining: 📦 Password resets remaining in your package: {remaining}
reset_pw_quota_granted_user: 🎉 Congratulations! You were given a package of {count} password resets. 📦 You have a total of {remaining} available.
reset_pw_quota_reduced_user: ⚠️ Limit reduced! Your password reset limit was reduced by {count}. 📦 Remaining: {remaining}.
reset_pw_failed_no_account: ❌ Account not found. No account exists for this Moonton email. Check the email address and send it again.
reset_pw_failed_too_many: ❌ Too many attempts! Moonton temporarily limited password resets. Please try again later (or tomorrow).
reset_pw_failed_auth:
❌ Authorization error connecting to the password reset service.
Report the error to the admins.
reset_pw_failed_quota:

Please try again in a bit.

❌ Could not get a response from the Moonton server.
Please try again in a bit.
reset_pw_failed_generic:
❌ Could not send the password reset email.
Please try again in a bit.
